attacks.name: Volt Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Superalloy Hands
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex or Pokémon V, this attack does 80 more damage.

power.name: Automated Combat
power.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Gemini Laser
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Zen Blade
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Zen Blade.

attacks.name: Laser Blade
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

power.name: Tachyon Bits
power.text: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to the Active Spot, you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Peak Acceleration
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards and attach them to your Future Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Repulsion Bolt
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 100 more damage.

attacks.name: Cyber Drive
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Cyber Drive.

cards.name: Boss's Orders (Ghetsis)
cards.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Ciphermaniac's Codebreaking
cards.text: Search your deck for 2 cards, shuffle your deck, then put those cards on top of it in any order. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Energy Retrieval
cards.text: Put up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Future Booster Energy Capsule
cards.text: The Future Pokémon this card is attached to has no Retreat Cost, and the attacks it uses do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

cards.name: Nest Ball
cards.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Professor Turo's Scenario
cards.text: Put 1 of your Pokémon in play into your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that Pokémon.) You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Professor's Research (Professor Turo)
cards.text: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Rika
cards.text: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck and put 2 of them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards and put them on the bottom of your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Super Rod
cards.text: Shuffle up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Switch
cards.text: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Techno Radar
cards.text: You can use this card only if you discard another card from your hand.    Search your deck for up to 2 Future Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Youngster
cards.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 5 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
